fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Madhya Pradesh High Court MPHC has released the notification for the post of Group-D, Liftman & Driver. This recruitment has been issued for 78 posts. Online applying process for MP High Court Class IV Recruitment 2025 has started from 13 May 2025 & the candidates can apply till 28 May 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for MP High Court Class IV Recruitment 2025 which has given below. 

Madhya Pradesh High Court MPHC, Jabalpur

MP High Court Class IV Recruitment 2025

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 09 May 2025
  • Application Start Date : 13 May 2025
  • Last Date : 28 May 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 May 2025
  • Correction Date : 01 June 2025
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, ST, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

MP High Court Class IV Notification 2025 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 01 October 2024
  • Minimum Age : 18 Years
  • Maximum Age : 35 Years
  • Age Relaxation as per MP High Court Class IV Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Age Calculate Tool – Click Here

MP High Court Class IV 2025 : Vacancy Details

Total Posts : 78 Posts

Post Name No. of Post
Class-IV (Contingency Paid) 69
Class-IV (Liftman) 01
Class-IV (Driver) 08

MP High Court Class IV Recruitment 2025 : Educational Qualification

Post Name Eligibility
Class-IV (Contingency Paid)
  • Minimum Class 8th Exam Passed & Maximum Class 12th Exam Passed from a Recognized Board.
Class-IV (Liftman)
  • Minimum Class 10th Exam Passed & Maximum Class 12th Exam Passed from a Recognized Board.
  • Wireman’s License and Experience in Lift Operations.
  • 2 Year Experience of Handling Work Relating to Operation of Lift and Knowledge of Electrical Work Connected with Lift Etc.
Class-IV (Driver)
  • Minimum Class 10th Exam Passed & Maximum Class 12th Exam Passed from a Recognized Board.
  • Valid Driving License and Experience of Driving All Types of Vehicles.

MP High Court Class IV Online Form 2025 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://mphc.gov.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the MP High Court before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other Sarkari Result 2025 Notification Here – Check Now.
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for MP High Court Class IV recruitment can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.

MP High Court Class IV Recruitment 2025 : Mode of Selection

  • Screening Of Documents
  • Interview (30 Marks)
  • Medical Examination

Q. When will Apply Online Link will Start for MP High Court Class IV Sarkari Result Recruitment 2025?
Answer. Online applications for this recruitment have started from 13 May 2025.

Q. What is Last Date of MP High Court Class IV Notification 2025?
Answer. The last date to apply online for this recruitment is 28 May 2025.

Q. What is Age Limit For MP High Court Class IV Vacancy 2025?
Answer. The age of the candidates applying for this recruitment as per MP High Court rules, see the post wise age information in the official information.

Q. What is Qualification For MP High Court Class IV Online Form 2025?
Answer. To apply for this recruitment, the candidate must have 8th, 10th, 12th pass read the official information completely before applying.

Q. How to Apply For MP High Court Class IV Bharti 2025?
Answer. To apply for this recruitment, first of all you have to go to the Official Sarkari Result which is SarkariExam.com and apply through this recruitment page. Through Sarkari Result Official you can apply for many government jobs.

Q. How to download the result of MP High Court Class IV Result 2025?
Answer. All those candidates who had given the exam for this recruitment can now download their result. To download your result, you can download it by entering registration number / roll number and DOB (Date of Birth). The official download link of the result will be made available in the important links above.

Q. What is MP High Court Official Website?
Answer. The Official Website of MP High Court is https://mphc.gov.in/
